wupp.description: Wupp is an unofficial, open-source WhatsApp companion client for Android that enhances the messaging experience through WhatsApp's linked-device functionality. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Go, it combines a modern native interface with a powerful WhatsApp connectivity bridge. Focused on privacy, customization, and convenience, Wupp introduces advanced privacy controls, enhanced message management, media features, and background synchronization while keeping your existing WhatsApp account and primary installation intact.
